subject: Your Northgate Student Card statement is ready
body:
Hi Jordan,

Your Northgate Student Card statement is ready.

Statement balance: $412.60
Minimum payment due: $35.00
Payment due date: {{day:+1@23:59}}
Purchase APR: 29.99%

If we don't receive at least your minimum payment by the due date, a late fee of up to $40 may apply and your account may be reported late.

View your statement and make a payment in the Northgate app.

Northgate Bank

subject: This Week at GT-like State: homecoming, study rooms, and more
body: Homecoming parade is Saturday at 10 AM on Central Avenue. The library added 12 bookable study rooms on floor 3. The dining hall is trying out late-night hours through November. Have a great week!

subject: Pre-approved! Upgrade to Northgate Platinum today
body: Great news, Jordan! You're pre-approved for the Northgate Platinum card with 3% cash back on dining. No annual fee the first year. Offer ends soon. Tap to accept in the app.

subject: Chess Club: blitz night Thursday
body: Blitz night is Thursday at 7 PM in Student Center 204. Bring a board if you have one. Pizza provided. All skill levels welcome!

sender: Dana Okafor (#opportunities, GT-like State CS Slack)
subject: Hope Forward Scholarship: $2,000, deadline coming up
body: Hey all! The Hope Forward Scholarship is open to sophomores and juniors in CS. It's a $2,000 award. Applications are due {{day:+2@17:00}}. You need a current resume and a 300-word essay on a problem you want to solve with tech. Apply through the department scholarship portal. Don't miss it!

subject: 50% off your next 3 rides
body: Heading home for the weekend? Get 50% off your next 3 rides with code CAMPUS50. Valid for new and returning riders. Terms apply.

subject: Reminder: file your conference travel reimbursement
body:
Hi Jordan,

Our records show you traveled to the Regional Undergraduate Research Conference. You are eligible for a reimbursement of $640 for registration and lodging.

Reimbursement requests must be filed in the travel portal with receipts by {{day:+5@17:00}}. Requests filed after the window closes cannot be paid.

University Travel Office

subject: Your BoxPrime Student membership renews soon
body:
Hi Jordan,

Your free BoxPrime Student trial ends and your paid membership renews on {{day:+2@09:00}}. You'll be charged $14.99/month to the card on file.

Don't want to continue? You can cancel anytime before your renewal date in Account > Memberships.

BoxPrime

subject: New: reserve study rooms online
body: You can now reserve library study rooms up to 7 days ahead from the library website. Rooms seat 2 to 6 people and have whiteboards and screens.

subject: Fall Career Fair is next week
body: Over 120 employers will be at the Fall Career Fair in the Campus Rec Center next Wednesday from 10 AM to 3 PM. Bring copies of your resume. Business casual recommended.

subject: 2-for-1 pizza tonight only
body: Study break? Get two large pizzas for the price of one tonight with code STUDY2. Delivery to all campus dorms.

subject: Action needed: submit your TA timesheet
body:
Hi Jordan,

Your teaching assistant timesheet for the current pay period (estimated pay: $380) has not been submitted. Timesheets must be submitted and approved in the payroll portal by {{day:+3@17:00}}. Hours not submitted by the deadline will not be paid this pay period.

University Payroll

subject: SGA minutes and upcoming town hall
body: Minutes from this week's Student Government meeting are posted. Our next town hall on campus parking is Monday at 6 PM in the Union Ballroom. Come share your thoughts!

subject: Your weekly mix is ready
body: We made a new mix based on what you've been listening to: 30 songs, 1 hr 52 min. Press play.

subject: Money tip: round up your purchases
body: Did you know you can round up every card purchase and save the change? Turn on Round-Ups in the Northgate app to start saving automatically.

subject: Reminder: your Northgate card payment is due soon
body:
Hi Jordan,

This is a reminder that your Northgate Student Card payment of at least $35.00 (statement balance $412.60) is due {{day:+1@23:59}}. Pay on time to avoid a late fee of up to $40.

Northgate Bank
